local_reverse_inventory.notes: Already used to generate inventory for affine.exe. No duplication needed.

local_reverse_corpus.notes: Already integrated with inventory. No duplication needed.

static_feature_extractor.notes: All functions are pure static analysis, no execution. Ready for affine.exe.

ida_runner_or_script.notes: local_reverse_ida_summary.py can run static IDA export. local_reverse_ida_guided_solver.py consumes IDA output. Both reusable.

ghidra_runner_or_script.notes: No dedicated Ghidra runner found in reverse_agent/. If needed, should be added as thin wrapper, not duplicate IDA logic.

capabilities: Forced IDA extraction for specific samples
forced_ida_extraction.notes: Exists but targeted at specific samples. Can be adapted if IDA summary is insufficient.

capabilities: Targeted static re-extraction for compare sites
targeted_static_reextract.notes: Exists for targeted re-extraction. Reusable if compare site location is known.

reuse_decision: reuse existing interfaces; do not create duplicate runners
recommended_next_steps: Run static_feature_extractor on affine.exe to get strings, entropy, keywords
If strings/keywords insufficient, configure and run local_reverse_ida_summary for static IDA export
If IDA export reveals compare sites, run local_reverse_targeted_static_reextract for detailed context
Do NOT create new runner modules; reuse existing tool_runners.py and local_reverse_ida_summary.py
avoid_duplication: Do not duplicate tool_runners IDA invocation logic
